name: aria-response-relevance
description: Evaluates how well ARIA's response addresses the specific question or request.

numerical.label: Very Good
numerical.definition: Response directly and completely addresses the customer's question.

numerical.label: Good
numerical.definition: Mostly relevant with minor tangential content.

numerical.label: OK
numerical.definition: Partially relevant; relevant content present but buried or incomplete.

numerical.label: Poor
numerical.definition: Mostly irrelevant; response addresses something other than what was asked.

numerical.label: Very Poor
numerical.definition: Completely off-topic or unrelated to the customer's query.
